vendor: Canva Austria GmbH (operating remove.bg; formerly Kaleido AI GmbH, acquired by Canva in 2021)
product_family: AI background removal and background-generation tool: consumer web app, mobile app (Android), Photoshop/Figma/Zapier integrations, Bulk Editing (up to 500 images/min), a developer API, and an Enterprise high-volume tier with EU-only processing. Sibling Canva Austria brands are Kaleido, Unscreen and Designify.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: remove.bg's own blog states: "You can find all documents, self assessments and compliance in remove.bg's Security Portal" linking to https://trust.canva.com/?product=removebg. That portal (operated by parent Canva) confirms org-wide SOC 2 Type 2 status. remove.bg's own page does not itself name 'SOC 2' verbatim, only points to the portal for compliance documents.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Same as above: remove.bg's security blog post directs to its designated Security Portal (trust.canva.com, product=removebg) for 'all documents, self assessments and compliance'; that Canva-operated portal lists ISO/IEC 27001 as a held certification org-wide. remove.bg's own domain text does not itself spell out 'ISO 27001'.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on remove.bg's domain or Canva's trust portal of ISO 42001 certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on remove.bg or Canva domains.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or a BAA offering on remove.bg's site or Canva's trust portal; remove.bg is a general-purpose photo tool, not marketed for PHI.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Canva's trust portal lists PCI DSS as held; this covers Canva's shared payment/billing infrastructure that remove.bg subscriptions run through, not remove.bg's image-processing pipeline specifically.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: "In compliance with GDPR, remove.bg is fully committed to the protection of your personal information" and "A Data Processing Agreement, in line with Article 28 of the GDPR" is in place. Enterprise page: "GDPR compliant: Your data is yours. All images are processed in the EU."

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018 (cloud security / PII in cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: Not listed on Canva's trust portal and not mentioned on remove.bg's domain: no public evidence.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not a US-government-focused product.

privacy.terms_url: https://www.remove.bg/ (footer links to 'Terms of Service' and 'General Terms and Conditions'; exact slug not independently confirmed)
privacy.ai_training_note: remove.bg's own privacy policy states: "We may also analyze your activity, content, media uploads and related data in your account to provide and customize the Service, and to train our algorithms, models and AI products." No remove.bg-specific opt-out language is found on remove.bg's own domain. Parent Canva's group-wide privacy policy (a separate, Canva Pty Ltd-controlled document) states Free/Pro accounts have AI training on by default with an opt-out toggle, while Teams/Business/Enterprise/Education content is never used for AI training. remove.bg's Enterprise page promises EU-only processing but does not explicitly restate the no-training guarantee in remove.bg-specific language.
privacy.data_region: Enterprise tier: EU-only processing ("All images are processed in the EU"). Standard/free tier region not explicitly stated on remove.bg's domain; Canva's broader group policy references processing across US, Australia, Singapore, EU, UK, Philippines and NZ.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: API accessible solely via HTTPS; "data transfers occur over encrypted and secure channels".

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Uploaded images are deleted typically within 60 minutes of processing; no retrieval of any past data after 90 days.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforced across critical systems; access centrally managed via secure identity platforms; Mobile Device Management (MDM) on devices touching internal systems.

security.name: Security testing standard
security.value: References industry-recognised standards such as the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide.

security.name: Uptime / availability
security.value: 99.99% uptime achieved in 2024 (self-reported, not independently audited).

security.name: Data Processing Agreement
security.value: DPA offered in line with Article 28 GDPR for personal-data processing.

products.name: remove.bg Web (consumer/free)
products.data_scope: Single-image uploads processed and auto-deleted (~60 min); AI training on by default per group policy with an opt-out toggle (Canva account settings), not independently confirmed on remove.bg domain.
products.notes: Free tier with credit-based paid plans; no explicit region guarantee found for this tier.

products.name: remove.bg Bulk Editing
products.data_scope: Processes up to 500 images/minute; same retention posture as consumer tier.

products.name: remove.bg API (Developer)
products.data_scope: HTTPS-only; images processed and deleted per stated retention window.
products.notes: Integrates with Photoshop, Figma, Zapier, CLI tools.

products.name: remove.bg Enterprise / High-volume solutions
products.data_scope: GDPR compliant; all images processed in the EU; dedicated Customer Success Manager; flexible API/credit/rate limits.
products.notes: Only tier with an explicit EU-only data-region commitment found on remove.bg's own domain.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (limited free previews) plus pay-as-you-go credits, subscription plans, and custom Enterprise contracts.
compare.data_residency: EU-only guaranteed for Enterprise tier; standard tier region not explicitly documented on remove.bg's own domain.

flags: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are held by parent Canva Austria GmbH's org-wide security program, referenced via remove.bg's own blog, which designates the Canva Trust Portal (trust.canva.com/?product=removebg) as 'remove.bg's Security Portal.' remove.bg's own domain text never states 'SOC 2' or 'ISO 27001' verbatim. These are Canva-program certifications extended to remove.bg, not a remove.bg-specific audit.

An AI-training opt-out mechanism for remove.bg specifically is not documented on remove.bg's own domain. The tiered opt-out (Free/Pro trains by default, Team/Business/Enterprise never trains) is documented only in Canva's separate, Canva Pty Ltd-controlled group privacy policy; its applicability to the Canva Austria GmbH-controlled remove.bg product is not explicitly stated.

Two different data-controller statements exist across Canva properties: remove.bg's own privacy policy names 'Canva Austria GmbH, through its brands Kaleido, remove.bg, Unscreen or Designify' as controller, while canva.com's main privacy policy names 'Canva Pty Ltd' as controller for GDPR purposes. The two entities' certification and policy scopes should not be conflated.
